6-Day Jordan Tour: Petra & Aqaba Red Sea Escape
summary:
The 6-Day Amman, Petra & Dead Sea Tour crosses Jordan from its northern historical sites to the Red Sea before ending at the Dead Sea. Start with Amman and the Roman ruins of Jerash, then follow the King’s Highway region through Madaba, Mount Nebo and Kerak Castle. Petra anchors the middle of the itinerary, while Aqaba introduces Jordan’s Red Sea coast before the final stay near the mineral-rich waters of the Dead Sea.
Six days cover considerable ground, so private road transport is used between destinations. Selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing are provided year-round.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amman
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Queen Alia International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Amman.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Tour of Amman, Jerash & the Dead Sea
itinerary.text: Explore Amman and visit the famous Roman Theater and Amman Citadel. Continue to Jerash, one of the best-preserved Roman cities in the Middle East. Visit the Forum, colonnaded streets, Nymphaeum, and the Temple of Artemis. Later, drive to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth, and enjoy free time to float in its mineral-rich waters. Return to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit the King's Highway, Madaba, Mount Nebo & Kerak Castle
itinerary.text: Visit Mount Nebo, where Prophet Moses viewed the Promised Land. Enjoy panoramic views over the Jordan Valley, the Dead Sea, Jericho, and Jerusalem. Continue to Madaba and see the famous mosaic map at the Saint George Church. Drive along the historic King's Highway and stop at Wadi Mujib for scenic views. Explore the impressive Kerak Castle before continuing to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Drive from Petra to Aqaba
itinerary.text: Explore Petra, the famous red-rose city of the Nabataeans. Walk through the Siq to reach the impressive Al-Khazneh (Treasury). Optional horse ride available at the entrance of Petra. Visit the Street of Facades, Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle before continuing to Aqaba on the Red Sea. Overnight in Aqaba.

itinerary.title: Aqaba at leisure
itinerary.text:
Free day in Aqaba to relax and enjoy the Red Sea resort atmosphere.
Optional activities include swimming, snorkeling, diving, or exploring the city, marina, and local markets.
Overnight in Aqaba.

Transfer to King Hussein International Airport according to your flight departure time

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 6-Day Jordan Holiday Package?
faqs.a: The 6-Day Jordan Holiday Package covers Amman, Petra, and Aqaba. This private itinerary combines Jordan's vibrant capital city, the world-famous archaeological site of Petra, and the beautiful Red Sea resort destination of Aqaba. The tour runs for 5 nights and 6 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 6-Day Jordan Holiday Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,095 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, an English-speaking driver, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and airport and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire journey. You will travel comfortably in a private vehicle with an English-speaking driver, providing flexibility and convenience during your stay in Jordan.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and convenient locations in Amman, Petra, and Aqaba.

faqs.q: Is a guide included in the tour?
faqs.a: This package includes an English-speaking driver rather than a full-time tour guide. Local guides can be arranged at major attractions such as Petra upon request. Your driver will assist with transportation, logistics, and general travel information throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience Jordan's most famous attraction, Petra, while also enjoying time in the capital city and relaxing on the shores of the Red Sea in Aqaba.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites and historic areas. Petra requires several kilometers of walking, while Aqaba offers mostly leisure activities suitable for all fitness levels.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Amman, Petra, and Aqaba?
faqs.a: Amman offers a fascinating blend of ancient and modern attractions, including the Citadel and Roman Theater. Petra is Jordan's most iconic UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for the Treasury and extraordinary rock-cut architecture. Aqaba is known for its beautiful beaches, snorkeling, diving, and vibrant Red Sea marine life.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 6-Day Jordan Holiday Package?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within the applicable cancellation period may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 6-Day Jordan Holiday Package be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be fully customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include Wadi Rum or the Dead Sea, arrange local guides, or modify the itinerary to match your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
